title: LIP: Lightweight Intelligent Preprocessor for meaningful text-to-speech
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical implementation of a preprocessor for Text-to-Speech (TTS) systems, including features like masking Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and censoring swear words. While these features touch upon privacy and social norms, the paper does not engage in evaluating or benchmarking ethical frameworks or moral principles themselves. Its scope is practical natural language processing for improved TTS output, not an ethical study.
